name: ai_multiplier_rules
purpose: Best-guess transparent rules that map AI capability/automation pressure to QoLI domain adjustments by horizon and scenario.

status_quo.description: High capture: productivity gains concentrate; displacement shocks households; weak protections.

wmr.description: Shared gains: productivity dividend + retraining + anti-monopoly + strong privacy.

notes: Adjustments are in QoLI points (0-100 domain score), capped to avoid unrealistic leaps.
These are scaffolds for later evidence-backed modeling.
